lines.en: I swim in the purple soda water.
My tail flicks side to side.
I swim around a candy column.
I swim slowly and steadily.
My scales are yellow.
I ride the current of the sweet water.
I pass through a stream of bubbles.

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，避开软糖熊。
lines.en: I turn away from a gummy bear.
I flick my tail and the ripples spread.
I circle by the soda weeds.
I sink slowly.
I rise up to the soda's surface.
I come out from behind a candy column.
My fins open and close in the purple water.
I follow the current around a bend.
I slide up along the candy wall.
I hover, gills working.
My eyes look both ways.
I turn in a slow circle.
I wait for something to fall in.

lines.zh: 我的小鳍一下下拨着水。
lines.en: My little fins paddle, one stroke at a time.
I press against a candy wall.
I blow a string of bubbles.
I look small in the purple water.
I hover in the purple water, fins still.
My colour is a little dull.

lines.zh: 我在数头顶落下的泡泡。
lines.en: I count the bubbles falling from above.

lines.zh: 我随着水流轻轻翻了个身。
lines.en: I roll gently with the current.
My mouth opens and closes.
I am in the shadow of a candy column.
You're standing at the pool's edge.

lines.zh: 你大得把整片水都遮住。
lines.en: You're big enough to blot out the whole pool.

lines.zh: 你的影子凉凉的，我停在这儿。
lines.en: Your shadow is cool; I'll stay here.
Your hand is too far.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水面上晃来晃去。
lines.en: Your face wobbles about on the surface.
The water is sweet. Want some?
I swim by your feet.
Don't put a finger in.
My colour matches the candy.
You're watching my tail.
I dart away.
I panicked and knocked into the candy wall.
The pain sends me darting in circles.
I hide behind a candy column.
I right myself in the water.
One of my fins won't quite obey me.
A scale is gone; I can still swim.
I keep to the bottom.
I blew a few bubbles.
I drift up along the bubbles.
Is that candy in your hand?
Drop it into the purple water.
I flick my tail and swim over.
It sank next to me.
I nudged it.
That's three times the size of my mouth.
That's not candy; I won't open my mouth.
Break the candy smaller before you drop it.
You're teasing me with candy.
One tail flick and I'm off.
The surface stirs and I dart off.
My scales are slick.
I hit a candy column.
The water clouds white.
I sink below the candy columns.
Don't slap the water; it stuns me.
I circle your feet once.
My tail brushes your hand.
One shove and I tumble twice.
I swim back out from the candy column.
My kind school in the water.

lines.zh: 你不在水里，成不了同伴。
lines.en: You aren't in the water; you can't be one of us.
I only want to swim in this water.
I flicked my tail.
There is too much candy here.
Just watch me.
My colour changes.
I hide in the bubbles.
I flick my tail and go.
I swish away with a flick of my tail.
I swim over and nudge it.
I can't swallow this.
I can't get this in one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖把它顶来顶去。
lines.en: I nudge it about with my snout.
I eat the candy crumbs in the water.
It sinks slowly to the candy floor.
I take it in my mouth once.
It slips out of my mouth.
This candy has no taste.
I swim away again.

lines.zh: 我头顶的水面多了一道影子。
lines.en: A new shadow falls on the water above me.
I swim over to look.
The surface moves. Something fell.

lines.zh: 我屏住鳃，盯住那团影子。
lines.en: I still my gills and stare at that shape.
I circle beside it.
That thing is sinking.

lines.zh: 那东西在紫水里沉得很慢。
lines.en: Whatever it is, it sinks slowly through the purple.
I nudge it and pull back.
I duck into the weeds.
I come out again.

lines.zh: 影子往哪边去，我往哪边。
lines.en: Wherever the shadow goes, I go.
I look at it from below.
I peek out from behind its tail.
It hit the bottom and stopped.
The water tastes of candy.
I dare move only half a foot at a time.
I flick my tail to hold position.
It stands between me and the candy column.

lines.zh: 我擦着它的侧面绕过去。
lines.en: I slip around its flank.

lines.zh: 我竖起背鳍给自己壮胆。
lines.en: I raise my dorsal fin to feel brave.
I puff my cheeks and bump into it.
I whip my tail at its ankle.
I lunge and catch only water.
I try one nibble.
No reaction. Not good to eat.
I flick back.
One more nudge and I bolt.
I have no teeth, only a small mouth.
That wasn't really a blow.
I flick my tail and swim off.
I appeared in the water.
This purple water is warm.
I flick my tail to test the water.
Candy all around me.
I swim one lap.
Is this water drinkable?
I look up at the surface.
My scales shine in the light.
I hide behind a candy column.

lines.zh: 我从糖洞的水里冒出来。
lines.en: I rise out of the candy cave's water.
The purple water heats; I dive.

lines.zh: 我从上面掉进水里，砸得很晕。
lines.en: I fell in from above and was stunned.

lines.zh: 我本来就在水里，可我还是难受。
lines.en: I live in water, and still it hurts.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀翻，我被冲走。
lines.en: The blast flips the water and sweeps me away.
A scale is scraped off my back.
Violet light chills the water.
There is little to eat in the water.

lines.zh: 电在水里散开，我翻了个身。
lines.en: The charge spreads; I flip over.
The water's gone; I can only flail.
